Each project below is built end to end on public or synthetic data. No
employer data, internal dashboards, or non-public policies appear anywhere
on this site — see [About](about.qmd) for why, and how each project stays
inside that boundary.

::: {.project-card}
### [Schedule 13G/13D Beneficial Ownership Reconciliation](projects/13g-reconciliation.qmd)

<span class="project-tag">R</span><span class="project-tag">SEC EDGAR API</span><span class="project-tag">Power BI</span><span class="project-tag">Regulatory Logic</span>

An end-to-end pipeline against SEC EDGAR's public filings API: fetches
Schedule 13D/13G filings, parses the structured XML cover pages introduced
by the December 2024 mandate, applies filing-deadline logic by filer type,
and exports a reconciled dataset to Power BI.

[Read the case study →](projects/13g-reconciliation.qmd)
:::
